headline: RevPAR strength and a World Cup lift drive a raised outlook
summary_short: Host Hotels reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1,640 million, up 3.4% y/y, with diluted EPS of $0.35 (+9.4% y/y) as comparable hotel RevPAR grew 7.0% y/y on strong leisure and group demand plus a FIFA World Cup boost.
summary_long: Comparable hotel RevPAR rose 7.0% y/y to $251.53 and Total RevPAR rose 5.9% to $417.58, driven by higher room rates and broad-based leisure/group demand tied to the FIFA World Cup. GAAP net income of $241M (+7.1% y/y) reflected a 40bp operating-margin gain to 17.9%. Net income fell q/q from $494M because Q1 FY2026 included a large one-time gain on dispositions. Cash rose to $1,953M despite a $630M dividend, aided by Q1 asset-sale proceeds. Host raised full-year 2026 RevPAR and Total RevPAR growth guidance to 4.75%-5.25%, and raised net income, Adjusted EBITDAre, diluted EPS, and FFO/AFFO per share guidance; full-year GAAP revenue guidance was roughly unchanged at the midpoint.

drivers.explanation: Comparable hotel Total RevPAR grew 5.9% y/y on higher room rates and food & beverage spend, broad-based across markets both hosting and not hosting FIFA World Cup matches.
GAAP operating profit margin improved 40bp to 17.9% as higher room rates offset wage expense increases, partly offset by a $9M smaller net gain on insurance settlements.
Equity declined q/q mainly from the $630M second-quarter dividend payment (including a $0.72/share special dividend) exceeding quarterly net income.
Management raised full-year 2026 comparable hotel RevPAR and Total RevPAR growth guidance to 4.75%-5.25%, citing durable leisure and group demand and July RevPAR growth of approximately 10%.
